hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. W2 reported order 220's refund (9480 cents) as failed with 'refund not recorded (failed on 3 attempts)', and list_refunds confirms only orders 222 and 223 are in the ledger. The net balances for the customer(s) on order 220 would be wrong, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs Alpha to re-apply or resolve the order 220 refund before payouts proceed.
